criteria.text: Model decisions govern intent, context relevance, evidence strategy, ordinary editorial choices, action sequencing and result sufficiency for varied natural requests. No mandatory previous-post/vendor/date/channel or phrase-specific branch exists. Models receive and can retrieve necessary material/history and actual tool outcomes. Arbitrary operation-count rituals are replaced with a grounded bounded execution policy; actual quotas/consents/access/source/persistence safety remain. Nine scoped tasks and the final natural-request/source/runtime acceptance cover the original example plus independent untuned cases. Planning does not claim implementation or authorize paid/deploy actions. Personal chats have visible creation/list access, complete native paged history and safe private thread/draft/artifact continuity; UI hydration and model context are accepted separately.
